sentences: Hard interaction rule: Don't mix 5-HTP casually with anything else that raises serotonin, whether it's a drug or a supplement.
Serotonin syndrome (MedlinePlus has an overview) is most often a multi-drug / stack problem.
There's case literature and clinical reviews warning about that risk with 5-HTP plus antidepressants or MAOIs.

In this dietary supplement interaction case report, a young guy on sertraline took 5-HTP along with a pile of weight-loss and energy supplements before working out, and it got so bad that surgeons had to cut open both his legs and his forearm to relieve the pressure (luckily he recovered).
If you're doing psychedelics, avoid 5-HTP on your psychedelic days, and be especially strict around ayahuasca / harmala MAOI chemistry and iboga / ibogaine.
